rows.text: There was a small wooden box on the table.
Her grandfather Ben sat by the window.
Its lid was firmly closed.
A brass latch held it fast.
A flag at the window hung limp.
Mara wanted to open the box.
She pushed the flag hard, and it swung and hung still again.
